content.comment_body: Hello, is it possible to adjust the source code of a customized [product_name] web server so that a browser on the PC plays a sound depending on the value of Q or M?
Do you have any examples of how to generate a sound in an HTML file, independently from a [product_name] output?
You may be able to do this using HTML or JavaScript code stored on the SD card. For example: var audio = document.createElement('audio'); audio.src = 'beep.mp3'; audio.play();

An example portion of an HTML file is attached, complete with comments showing how to interpret values. Using this, you can locate any bit's position (input, output, or flag) in your own file. Then, insert an if...then structure after the commented section highlighted in blue. Digital values should typically be 0 or 1.
Thanks for your help. I will give it a try.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is seeking a method to enable audio notifications triggered by specific values (Q or M) in customized [product_name] web server pages. The current product does not offer this feature natively, so users are exploring custom solutions using HTML and JavaScript. This discussion indicates a need for improved support for interactive feedback functions in the web server interface.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes that the [product_name] web server will either provide built-in support for audio feedback or allow for simple implementation through scripting or configuration, based on automation values.
